name: Secular Music
overview: Scripture warns believers to be discerning about what they listen to, highlighting that the words we hear can influence our hearts and minds. Proverbs 17:4 and Ecclesiastes 7:5 caution against giving ear to falsehood and foolish songs, urging us to prefer wise rebuke over empty entertainment. Luke 21:34 reminds Christians to guard their hearts from being overwhelmed by worldly distractions, which can dull spiritual alertness. Ultimately, Romans 12:1 calls for a life wholly dedicated to God, implying that our choices, including music, should honor Him rather than seek the praise of men as warned in John 12:43.
